A tank holds 30 g in 60 L; add 3 g/min and 2 L/min. Write c(t) and its long-run level.
For (x²−9)/(x−3), locate the hole.
IndependentTryItStudentQuestions.TeacherExpectedMath: Hole at (3,6); the original domain excludes 3.

IndependentTryItStudentQuestions.Question: Construct a rational function with zero x=2, vertical asymptote x=−1, horizontal asymptote y=3.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Explain why p(x)=x³−2x+4 is polynomial while r(x)=(x²+1)/(x−3) is rational.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: p uses nonnegative integer exponents and no nonconstant denominator. r is a quotient of polynomials and is undefined at x=3.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Compare continuity of p(x)=2x²+1 and r(x)=1/(x+1) over real inputs.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: p is continuous at every real x; r is undefined and has a vertical asymptote at x=−1.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Explain why r(x)=(x−4)(x+2)/((x−4)(x−1)) has a hole at x=4.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: A common factor x−4 cancels in the expression, but the original domain excludes 4. The simplified value at 4 is (4+2)/(4−1)=2, giving hole (4,2).

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Give an example of a rational function with no vertical asymptotes and justify it.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: 1/(x²+4): the denominator has no real zeros, so no real vertical asymptotes.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Give a rational function with no real x-intercepts and justify it.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: (x²+1)/(x−2): the numerator is always positive, so no x-intercepts; domain excludes 2.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find the domain of f(x)=(x+2)/(x−4).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: All real x except 4.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find the original domain of f(x)=(x−3)/(x²−9) and classify each excluded input.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Exclude −3 and 3; x=3 is a hole at y=1/6 and x=−3 is a vertical asymptote.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find the domain of f(x)=(x²+1)/(x²+x−6).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Factor denominator (x+3)(x−2). Exclude −3 and 2.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find the domain of f(x)=(x+5)/(x⁴−10x²+9).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Denominator=(x²−1)(x²−9). Exclude −3,−1,1,3.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find domain, vertical and horizontal asymptotes of 7/(x+5).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Exclude −5; vertical x=−5; horizontal y=0.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find domain and asymptotes of 3/(2x−7).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Exclude 7/2; vertical x=7/2; horizontal y=0.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find domain and asymptotes of x/(x²−16).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Exclude −4 and 4; vertical x=±4; horizontal y=0.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find domain and asymptotes of (x+1)/(x²−3x−10).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Denominator=(x−5)(x+2). Exclude 5 and −2; both are vertical asymptotes, horizontal y=0.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find real vertical and horizontal asymptotes of (x+6)/(x³−8).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Denominator real zero x=2, numerator nonzero there. Vertical x=2; horizontal y=0. Domain excludes 2.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find domain and asymptotes of (2x+1)/(x³−9x).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Denominator x(x−3)(x+3). Exclude −3,0,3; all vertical, horizontal y=0.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find domain and asymptotes of (x²−4)/(x(x+3)(x+5)).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Exclude −5,−3,0; numerator nonzero at all three, so verticals there; horizontal y=0.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Classify all discontinuities and the horizontal asymptote of (x−4)/(x²−16).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Domain excludes −4 and 4; hole at (4,1/8); vertical asymptote x=−4; horizontal y=0.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find domain and vertical/horizontal asymptotes of (x+2)/(x−1).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Exclude 1; vertical x=1; horizontal y=1.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find domain and asymptotes of (6−3x)/(2x+1).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Exclude −1/2; vertical x=−1/2; horizontal y=−3/2.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find the x- and y-intercepts of (x−6)/(x²+1).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: x-intercept (6,0); y-intercept (0,−6).

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find intercepts and hole of f(x)=x/(x²+2x).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Original domain excludes 0 and −2; simplifies to 1/(x+2). Hole at (0,1/2); no x-intercept and no y-intercept.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find intercepts of (x²−5x+4)/(x²+4x+3).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: x-intercepts (1,0) and (4,0); y-intercept (0,4/3). Denominator roots −1,−3 do not cancel.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find all real intercepts of (x²+x+2)/(x²−5x+6).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: No x-intercepts: numerator discriminant 1−8<0; y-intercept (0,1/3).

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find the x- and y-intercepts of (50−2x²)/(x²−9).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: x-intercepts (−5,0) and (5,0); y-intercept (0,−50/9). Denominator excludes ±3.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Determine local one-sided behavior and long-run level of x/(3x+2).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Vertical x=−2/3; horizontal y=1/3; as x→−2/3− function→+∞ and x→−2/3+ function→−∞.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Analyze local and end behavior of 3x/(x−4).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Vertical x=4; horizontal y=3; left side tends −∞ and right side +∞.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Analyze local and end behavior of −3x/(x−4).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Vertical x=4; horizontal y=−3; left side tends +∞ and right side −∞.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Analyze the local and end behavior of (x²−1)/(x²−9).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Vertical x=±3; horizontal y=1. At −3: left +∞, right −∞. At 3: left −∞, right +∞.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find the vertical and horizontal asymptotes and local signs of (x²−16)/(x²−1).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Vertical x=±1; horizontal y=1. At −1: left −∞, right +∞. At 1: left +∞, right −∞.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find the slant asymptote of (6x²+5x)/(2x+1).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Divide to get 3x+1−1/(2x+1). Slant y=3x+1.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find the slant asymptote of (8x²−3)/(2x−1).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Divide to get 4x+2−1/(2x−1). Slant y=4x+2.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find the slant asymptote of (12x²+8x+1)/(3x+2).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Divide to get 4x+1/(3x+2). Slant y=4x.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find end-behavior slant asymptote of (4x³+x)/(2x²+1).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Divide to get 2x−x/(2x²+1). Slant y=2x.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Find the slant asymptote of (x²+3x+1)/(x−2).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Divide to get x+5+11/(x−2). Slant y=x+5.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Graph a reciprocal shifted three units down; state both asymptotes.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: f(x)=1/x−3; vertical x=0, horizontal y=−3. Use two reciprocal-shaped branches.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Graph a reciprocal shifted left two and up one; identify both asymptotes.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: f(x)=1/(x+2)+1; vertical x=−2, horizontal y=1.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Graph the reciprocal squared shifted three units left; identify asymptotes.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: f(x)=1/(x+3)²; vertical x=−3, horizontal y=0. Both branches positive.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Graph reciprocal squared shifted right two and up three; identify asymptotes.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: f(x)=1/(x−2)²+3; vertical x=2, horizontal y=3. Both branches above y=3.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Sketch f=(3x−2)/(x+1) with all intercepts and asymptotes.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: x-intercept (2/3,0); y-intercept (0,−2); vertical x=−1; horizontal y=3.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Sketch f=(x+4)/(2x−1) with all intercepts and asymptotes.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: x-intercept (−4,0); y-intercept (0,−4); vertical x=1/2; horizontal y=1/2.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Sketch f=5/(x−1)² with intercepts and asymptotes.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: No x-intercept; y-intercept (0,5); vertical x=1; horizontal y=0. Positive on each side.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Sketch f=3/(x+2)² with intercepts and asymptotes.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: No x-intercept; y-intercept (0,3/4); vertical x=−2; horizontal y=0.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Sketch f=(x²−4)/(x²−9) and label key features.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: x-intercepts (±2,0); y-intercept (0,4/9); vertical x=±3; horizontal y=1.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Sketch g=(2x²−5x−3)/(x²−1) and label key features.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: x-intercepts (−1/2,0),(3,0); y-intercept (0,3); vertical x=±1; horizontal y=2.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Identify the hole, intercepts and asymptotes of (x²+3x+2)/(x²−1).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: After cancelling x+1, hole (−1,−1/2); vertical x=1; x-intercept −2; y-intercept −2; horizontal y=1.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Identify the hole, intercepts and asymptotes of (x²−5x+6)/(x²−4).
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: After cancelling x−2, hole (2,−1/4); vertical x=−2; x-intercept 3; y-intercept −3/2; horizontal y=1.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Sketch (x²+4x+3)/(x−2), recording intercepts and end behavior.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: x-intercepts −3,−1; y-intercept −3/2; vertical x=2; slant y=x+6.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Sketch (2x²+x−3)/(x−3), recording intercepts and end behavior.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: x-intercepts −3/2,1; y-intercept 1; vertical x=3; slant y=2x+7.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: For f=(x−2)(x+1)(x−4)/((x+3)²(x−5)), sketch from factored features.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Zeros 2,−1,4; y-intercept −8/45; vertical x=−3 (double),5; horizontal y=1.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: For g=(x+3)²(x−2)/((x−4)(x+2)(x+5)), sketch from factored features.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: Zeros −3 (double),2; y-intercept 9/20; vertical x=4,−2,−5; horizontal y=1.

Construct a rational function with verticals −2 and −6, zeros 3 and −1, horizontal y=5.

FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Construct a rational function with vertical x=4, double zero x=−1, y-intercept −1/4.
